messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline is FDA-approved to treat six conditions in adults:
Major depressive disorder (MDD), the clinical term for depression.
Obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD), where unwanted thoughts drive repeated behaviors.
Panic disorder, which causes sudden attacks of intense fear along with physical symptoms.
Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD), which can follow a frightening or traumatic event.
Social anxiety disorder (SAD), also called social phobia.
Premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD), a severe form of premenstrual symptoms.
In children and teenagers, sertraline is approved only for OCD, from age 6 upward.
Sertraline's safety and effectiveness have not been established in children under 6 years of age.
Sertraline's safety and effectiveness have not been established in children and teenagers for any condition other than OCD.
Not every sertraline product is approved for all six conditions:
Sertraline tablets and oral solution are approved for all of them.
Triplet: ["sertraline", "not approved for in children under 6 years of age", "any condition"]

The relation 'not approved for in children under 6 years of age' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is not approved for the condition specified by the object entity in children under the age of 6.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
B. 'not interchangeable with': The subject drug cannot be substituted directly for the drug specified by the object entity.
C. 'not chemically related to': The subject drug is not chemically similar to or related to the substance specified by the object entity.
D. 'has unstudied dose': The subject drug has not been studied at the dose specified by the object entity.
E. 'not used for': The subject drug is not indicated or used for the condition, situation, or purpose specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
